component.name: Apsis
component.summary: Timeshift-style system snapshots for the COSMIC™ desktop

description.p: Apsis is a panel applet for the COSMIC desktop that lists, creates and deletes system snapshots through Timeshift. Its popup looks like a small terminal, works with the keyboard or the mouse, and follows the live COSMIC theme.

ul.li: Snapshot list with tags, comments and a details pane
Create and delete snapshots, with one password prompt per few minutes through a small polkit-guarded helper
Timeshift settings: backup device, schedules, home folders and filters
Vim-style keys and a command line, or the mouse
Also opens as a resizable window from the app launcher
Experimental: a native rsync backend that creates Timeshift-compatible snapshots, with a dry run first
Experimental: browse a snapshot's files and restore them to a folder in your home, or back to their original place

description.p: Timeshift must be installed and set up. Full-system restore is left to Timeshift.

screenshot.caption: The popup: snapshot list, details and activity

ul.li: A .deb package for Pop!_OS and Ubuntu 24.04 or newer, attached to each release
A "How to use" guide in the README
Fixed: just vendor now writes vendor.tar, and just build-vendored builds offline
List, create and delete Timeshift snapshots from a COSMIC panel applet
Terminal-style popup and window mode, keyboard and mouse
apsis-helper: a D-Bus service guarded by polkit
Experimental native rsync backend and file-level restore
